observations.description: Readable input labels and distinct component colors. Positive components point right; the negative component points left.
Identity arrows retain their lengths, colors and signed directions while advancing from the earlier sample.
Identity and correction paths are distinguishable through headings and separate lanes. Correction directions match their displayed signs.
Corrections remain separate as merging begins; identity arrows remain unchanged.
Matching colors preserve component correspondence as corrections approach identity endpoints. Overlapping orange arrows slightly reduce local clarity.
Outputs depict componentwise addition, not concatenation: 1.20 rightward, −0.10 leftward and 0.15 rightward.
Bold output values and separate result lanes make the sums readable while retaining the contributing components.
The result remains visible across the late samples, providing reading time. This sampled-frame pass does not establish full-video smoothness or user artistic acceptance.
